notes.title: The Second Version of the Early Access is Here!
Performance and Quality of Life Improvements
notes.content:
Improvements have been made to fix performance issues that caused crashes for some users. Players now have more freedom to select the optimal quality settings for their system. Additionally, a skill mechanic has been adjusted so that its cooldown will no longer trigger if the first projectile has not been fired and the action is interrupted by damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42348200/9777a08bdec3e449696d578efb088c30d7522546.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Mouse navigation for menus
[*] Five Quality Options
[*] Main Menu with quality, brightness, and control options
[*] Skill no longer enters cooldown if interrupted before firing a projectile
[/list]

notes.title: Now fully compatible with keyboard and mouse!
notes.content:
Now all help commands that appear on screen will also be shown if you use keyboard and mouse to play:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42348200/34aa20ae263c5b8b0a0f5cfd13af307a74300027.png[/img]

notes.title: Fixed Re-equip Perk glitch and minors changes
notes.content:
- Fixed the issue with the Re-equip Perk that caused the player to become immortal and have infinite stamina
- Fixed when you already have the OnlySide door open, but the door still shows the Open Door message
- Minor changes in scenario and boss enemy behavior (wip)
